description:
Turn ACTION: lines in notes and logs into anchored TASK: lines, and edit those anchors in place. The note and log files are the only task store.

Usage (bare): [] or ["--dry-run"] or ["--quiet"]. Same as ingest. Put these flags before any subcommand.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line in notes and logs as a TASK: anchor with a new 8-char uuid
  add THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — append an ACTION to buffer.md (same as buffer add-action)
  done UUID — change TASK to DONE and stamp end:<today>
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L (writes [#X])
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make UUID wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread THREAD] [--assignee PERSON] [--overdue] [--json] — pending tasks, grouped by thread A-Z, then priority/due/entry
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due, entry
  show UUID — detail view of one task

Flags:
  ingest (or bare):
    --dry-run  show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet    suppress per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD        due date
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD  scheduled date
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8         full 8-char uuid from tasks list; repeatable
  list:
    --priority H|M|L     only this priority
    --thread THREAD      only tasks whose source note carries this thread, e.g. Projects/Northwind
    --assignee PERSON    only this assignee
    --overdue            only tasks whose due date is before today
    --json               JSON output

Args:
  UUID, DEP_UUID  task uuid from tasks list; any unique prefix works (rm-depends: any prefix matching one of this task's dependencies)
  TEXT (add)      "(Assignee) description" or "description"
  PERSON          name with a file at people/<Name>.md; a leading people/ is allowed
  DATE            YYYY-MM-DD

Examples:
  ["list", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["add", "Projects/Northwind", "(Sam Rivera) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-11-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-12-01"]

Notes:
  add only writes to the buffer. The task exists after buffer flush, which ingests it; no need to run tasks afterwards.
  ingest, done, set-*, add-depends and rm-depends rewrite note and log files in place. Never edit TASK:/DONE: lines by hand.
  Nothing prompts.
  Exit 1: no task matches the uuid prefix, empty prefix, date not YYYY-MM-DD, empty description, person has no people/<Name>.md, task made to depend on itself.
